ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes characterized by high-intensity white regions; peripheries and distal tips bounded by low-intensity black pigmentation; left lobe features two distinct, circular low-intensity black blobs; right lobe exhibits a transition from white to a dense stippled gray-black mottling towards the distal edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 138 degrees and shallow vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary; left lobe trailing edge contains five primary macro-peaks; right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher-frequency, lower-amplitude serrations with a significant indentation approximately two-thirds from the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to sharp, narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular low-intensity clusters on the mid-left lobe; a cluster of high-intensity white pixel spots (approx. 3-4) located on the black-pigmented right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions observed on the lower proximal region of the left lobe near the water interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent circular black marks on the left lobe; two distinct high-intensity white calcified protrusions (likely barnacles) located on the extreme upper margin of the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique twin-spot high-intensity marker on the right apex margin providing a high-contrast break against the black background.
